description: PandaCSS @layer utilities block of the consumer desktop renderer stylesheet.

extraction.denominatorRule: Alpha 1 baseline: every declaration except custom properties and declarations inside @keyframes, restricted to @layer utilities. Excluded declarations stay in the set with their reason.
extraction.selectorPolicy: Selectors are not published; only allow-listed pseudo-classes, pseudo-elements and state attribute names are kept. Declarations are identified by ordinal only.
extraction.redactionPolicy: Every value and condition token that is not CSS vocabulary, a number with a CSS unit, a hex color, an approved identifier or punctuation is replaced by a placeholder carrying a keyed HMAC-SHA256 digest of the removed text, as are url(), quoted strings, e-mail addresses, URIs, opaque tokens, non-ASCII text, unapproved custom-property and layer names and unclean query parameters.
